name: Parvati River
description: A pristine river flowing through Kasol, perfect for riverside walks and picnics with stunning Himalayan views.

name: Tosh Village
description: A charming mountain village known for its scenic beauty, traditional Himachali culture, and vibrant cafes.

name: Kheerganga Trek
description: A famous trek leading to natural hot springs surrounded by lush forests and panoramic mountain views.

name: Malana Village
description: An ancient village with a unique culture and self-governance, famous for its distinct architecture and local customs.

name: Kasol Market
description: Bustling local market offering handicrafts, local produce, and a variety of cafes serving Israeli and Himachali cuisine.

name: Chalal Village
description: A quaint village near Kasol known for its peaceful ambiance, scenic trails, and traditional wooden houses.

name: Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara
description: A sacred Sikh pilgrimage site famous for its hot springs and beautiful architecture nestled in the mountains.

name: Rudra Nag Waterfall
description: A serene waterfall located near Kasol, ideal for nature lovers seeking tranquility and scenic beauty.

name: Bhuntar Airport
description: The nearest airport to Kasol, serving as the gateway to the Parvati Valley and surrounding Himalayan destinations.

name: Garhwal Trekking Base Camp
description: Starting point for various treks in the Parvati Valley, offering equipment rental and local guide services.

name: Rudra Nag Temple
description: A small but revered temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, located near the Rudra Nag waterfall.

name: Pin Parvati Pass Trek
description: A challenging high-altitude trek connecting Parvati Valley to Spiti Valley, offering breathtaking mountain vistas.

name: Kasol Israeli Cafe Street
description: A street lined with cafes serving authentic Israeli cuisine, popular among tourists and backpackers.

name: Manikaran Hot Springs
description: Natural hot springs believed to have medicinal properties, attracting visitors for bathing and relaxation.

name: Kasol Riverside Camping
description: Experience camping by the Parvati River with bonfires, star gazing, and local music in a serene environment.

name: Pulga Village
description: A small village known for its apple orchards, peaceful surroundings, and traditional Himachali lifestyle.

name: Rudra Nag River Walk
description: A scenic walking trail along the Rudra Nag river, perfect for a peaceful stroll amidst nature.

name: Kasol Yoga and Meditation Center
description: A tranquil center offering yoga and meditation sessions with Himalayan mountain views for rejuvenation.

name: Kullu Valley Viewpoint
description: A panoramic viewpoint offering breathtaking vistas of the Kullu Valley and surrounding snow-capped peaks.

name: Kasol Art and Handicraft Shop
description: A shop showcasing local handicrafts, traditional woolens, and unique souvenirs made by Himachali artisans.
